baslik: The Deadliest Natural Disaster in U.S. History

sahneler.metin: This is the deadliest natural disaster in American history.
September eighth, 1900. Galveston, Texas, a booming island city.
The highest point on the whole island was under nine feet above the sea.
There was no seawall, and forecasters waved the danger away.
Then a category four hurricane drove a fifteen foot wall of water ashore.
The surge swallowed the entire island in a single night.
As many as eight thousand people were killed.
Survivors raised the whole city by several feet and built a seawall.
One storm rewrote how America prepares for hurricanes.
